game_title: Digit Mill – Ore Vein Depths Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths, a rich ore vein: the cave miner must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Ore Vein Depths: a rich ore vein
core_gameplay_loop: In Ore Vein Depths, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round, a new torches challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 300 points of torches by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 300, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Ore Vein Depths.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 300 within 45 seconds.
